entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary:
The Tatra Electric Railway, colloquially Tatra Railway, is an electrified single track 1,000 mm narrow gauge railway in the Slovak part of the Tatra mountains. It consists of two connected lines:Poprad – Starý Smokovec – Štrbské Pleso (29,1 km)
Starý Smokovec – Tatranská Lomnica (5,9 km)
